newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan thieves steal rare violin.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan thieves steal rare violin.

text.p: Cultured thieves stole an 18th century violin and two bows valued at $540,000 from a leading European soloist visiting Venezuela, El Nacional newspaper reported on Tuesday.
Felix Ayo, 63, a Spanish musician who lives in Italy, noticed the theft when he returned to his room in a luxury hotel in the centre of Caracas on Sunday, the paper reported.
The Guadagnini violin, made in 1744, was valued at $500,000. Police were interviewing hotel staff about the robbery.
